tools.name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2
tools.capability: Image-to-3D textured static mesh generation with Base Color/Roughness/Metallic/Opacity; upstream output GLB.
tools.code_and_model_license: MIT; keep copyright and license notice when applicable
license_cautions: NVIDIA nvdiffrast and nvdiffrec have separate license terms; audit before actual hosted/commercial deployment.
Source images and any third-party services must have suitable permissions and independent pricing/terms.
tools.hardware: Official local workflow Linux + NVIDIA GPU with >=24GB VRAM; tested A100/H100. Not supported by 2GB VRAM target.
tools.cost: Open-source MIT code/model freely available; GPU compute or third-party hosted demos may cost money; no promise of free browser service.
fit_for_shire: Static decorative props: garden tools, crockery, barrels, baskets, sacks, furniture, isolated rocks and landmark dressing after author review.
Early concepts for Hobbit-hole architectural detailing before mesh repair.
not_approved_for: Direct insertion of unoptimized 1M-triangle/4K-texture GLB assets into UE4
Direct production animated characters or horses without manual retopology, humanoid skeletal rig, animation and deformation QC
Any copyrighted reference image without rights
intake_pipeline: Run externally only if approved service/GPU is available.
Record source image rights, prompt, model version, generated mesh and cost.
Review front/back silhouette, manifold/smoothing/UVs, collision dimensions and story canon.
Blender conversion from GLB to static FBX (skeletal FBX plus validated animations for characters only).
Reduce triangles/LOD/collision; export PNG/TGA channel-packed textures with 1K default when suitable and preserve PBR provenance.
Keep candidate in warehouse quarantine until hash/license/performance/import checks pass; only then promote on serialized P1C01 runtime lane.
tools.gate_policy: No new runtime chapter or Gate 6/7 status change; candidate/tool catalogue only. No GPU job, inference or file acquisition performed.
